description: Master player dimension with unified IDs across all data sources. Single source of truth for player identity.

columns.name: master_player_id
columns.description: Unified player ID (SHA-256 hash of normalized player name). Primary key.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Player display name (most common spelling across sources)

columns.name: player_name_normalized
columns.description: Uppercase normalized name for matching (no suffixes, special chars removed)

columns.name: position
columns.description: Primary playing position. Uses highest priority position when multiple exist.

columns.name: headshot_url
columns.description: Player headshot image URL (from nflverse when available)

columns.name: sources
columns.description: List of data sources where this player appears

columns.name: source_count
columns.description: Number of distinct sources player appears in (1-4)

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when player record was created in gold layer

relationships.description: Maps to source-specific player IDs (sleeper_id, espn_id, nflverse_id)
Player's weekly fantasy stats across all sources

data_quality_rules: Position priority: Valid positions (QB/RB/WR/TE) override invalid (UNK/N/A)
Headshot URLs: Only from nflverse source (most reliable)

common_queries.sql: SELECT * FROM main.fantasai.gold_player_dim WHERE position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE')
SELECT * FROM main.fantasai.gold_player_dim WHERE display_name LIKE '%Patrick Mahomes%'

common_queries.description: Players in multiple sources (data quality check)
common_queries.sql: SELECT * FROM main.fantasai.gold_player_dim WHERE source_count > 1 ORDER BY source_count DESC

frontend_usage.player_detail: master_player_id is the key for all API calls
frontend_usage.player_avatar: headshot_url for player images (null fallback to default avatar)
